h: The Blessings of Shabbos Restore Food and Human Radiance

p: that you find favor in His eyes,
if only you would find favor before Me
And this saying is in the Midrash
וַיַּרְא אֱלֹהִים אֶת כָּל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה
"And God saw all that He had made,
and behold, it was very good,"
which was said at the onset of Shabbos.
And it appears that the Ramban explains
is like the blessing of Shabbos;
on "May He bless you and guard you"
and on "be gracious to you" he cited their midrash
And that is because it is written (Bereishis 2:3):
and it does not mention with what He blessed it;
which is spelled out in the Torah.
And there is a proof for his words
from what is written in the holy Zohar
(רַעְיָא מְהֵימְנָא פִּנְחָס, חֵלֶק ג רמה, א)
about the secret of the twelve loaves,
which correspond to the three Names Havayah
That is, the blessing of Shabbos
And likewise "He blessed it with the manna
and sanctified it with the manna"
Now from where did they learn
that the blessing is in eating?
True, we find blessing in eating,
"And He will bless your bread and your water,
But it is as we said,
and it is written "May Hashem bless you"
and they expounded in the Sifrei (Naso 40):
"with the blessing that is spelled out,"
'Blessed is your basket and your kneading trough'";
and that is a blessing in eating.

p: blessing is the opposite of curse;
and in the curse of Adam and Chavah
we do not find the word "cursed,"
since a blessing was said to them specifically,
a curse was not said of them;
just as the beasts were not blessed
who was destined for a curse,
so that he not be included in a blessing
(as Rashi, of blessed memory, explained, Bereishis 1:22);
and all the more so with man,
to whom a blessing was said specifically.
And when a language of curse was said,
"Cursed is the ground because of you," etc.
from the side of the Tree of Life,
the taste of the Tree of Life,
"And the Tree of Life in the midst of the garden"
from the Tree of Knowledge of Good and Evil,
"Thorns and thistles it shall sprout for you,
and you shall eat the grass of the field";
and after his face broke out in sweat
"Shall I be tied to the trough like an animal?"
"By the sweat of your brow you shall eat bread"
that it be only from the side of good,
that the eating be in holiness;
And this is along the lines of what they said
that is, "the heart of the wise man is to his right
and the heart of the fool to his left" (Koheles 10:2)
"and after he has eaten and drunk,
But it depends on the eating:
אָז מֵבִיא לִידֵי שְׁלִיטַת יֵצֶר הָרָע
then it brings about the rule of the evil inclination,
וְיֵשׁ לוֹ רַק הַלֵּב כְּסִיל לִשְׂמֹאלוֹ
and he has only the fool's heart to his left;
"And you will eat and be sated;
and the Sifrei on Parshas Eikev expounds
that a person does not rebel
against the Holy One, blessed be He,
and brings it from several pesukim
But when the eating is in holiness,
the heart of the wise man to his right.
And this is the blessing in the eating of Shabbos,
And this is "May Hashem bless you"
and this is "and guard you" — from the evil inclination
לֹא תָּבִיא לִידֵי שְׁלִיטַת הַיֵּצֶר הָרָע
will not bring about the rule of the evil inclination,
שֶׁהוּא לְכוּ לַחֲמוּ בְלַחְמִי (מִשְׁלֵי ט, ה)
which is "Come, eat of my bread" (Mishlei 9:5).
And this is the meaning of "He blessed it with delicacies":
that the eating be in holiness;
as is written in the holy Zohar
regarding the Kohanim's eating of the showbread:
"And because of that bread, food," etc.,
the food they eat and drink,
דְּלָא לְקַטְרְגָא בְּהוּ יֵצֶר הָרָע וְכוּלֵּי
so that the evil inclination not accuse them," etc.;
and it was effective for all their weekday eating.
which is the opposite of the curse,

p: And though we do find the word "cursed" with a man,
and likewise Avraham said to Eliezer,
"The cursed does not cleave to the blessed,"
and they are "a people likened to a donkey"
'Whose flesh is the flesh of donkeys'";
all the nations are called "the children of Noach,"
"'That I do not benefit from the children of Noach'
he is permitted with Yisrael," etc.;
"that I do not benefit from the children of Adam,"
are called the children of Adam.
since he was created in His image,
when his radiance was taken away,
as is written in Bereishis Rabbah
from the verse "You change his countenance and send him away" (Iyov 14:20)
when he entered the Cave of Machpelah,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בְּבָבָא בַּתְרָא נח, א
as is written in Bava Basra 58a,
he returned to the original light of his face,
as is evident from what is written there:
"Do not gaze at My very image."
And this is what is written in the Midrash
"He blessed it with the light of man's face;
Yisrael merits the light of the face;
"a soul in which there is all perfection,"
And this is "May Hashem shine His face upon you":
"this is the light of the Shechinah," etc.
but there are levels in this,
as is written in the holy Zohar
(פָּרָשָׁה זוֹ, רַעְיָא מְהֵימְנָא, חֵלֶק ג קכב, ב)
in His image, in the image of God'
male from the side of the letter yud,
and female from the side of the letter hei."
And that is as is written
And it says in the Pesikta
with the matters of this world
on it one should make it entirely Torah
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בְּתַנָּא דְּבֵי אֵלִיָּהוּ רַבָּה פֶּרֶק א)
(as written in Tanna d'Vei Eliyahu Rabbah, chapter 1);
and on Shabbos there is bestowed upon them
by Hashem, may He be blessed, words of Torah
only then "you shall delight in Hashem" (Yeshayahu 58:14).
who are occupied with work all week,
and they too are "in the image of God,"
the image from the side of the letter hei;
"The awe of Shabbos is upon the unlearned";
in the holy Zohar and the Tikkunim
that He makes them a dwelling
in the two chambers of the heart,
and this is the attribute of Malchus:
who are Shabbosos and Yamim Tovim,
and Hashem, may He be blessed, dwells within their hearts
then on Shabbos they attain the light of the face,
the image from the side of the letter yud,
which is Chochmah, the supernal holiness.
And this is what is written
which are called additional souls," etc.,
That is, Torah scholars on weekdays
also merit the light of the Shechinah,
which is "in the image of God,"
from the side of the letter hei;
and on Shabbos they merit the image "in His image,"
from the side of the letter yud.
And this is "He blessed it with the light of the face," etc.
And this is what the Ramban wrote:
that you find favor in His eyes,
הַלְוַאי תְּהֵא מַעֲלַת חֵן לְפָנַי וְכוּלֵּי
if only you would find favor before Me," etc.;
all of creation found favor in His eyes;
He blessed it with the light of the face.
Adam HaRishon said "and I will eat" (Bereishis 3:12);
and it says in Midrash Rabbah
I ate and I will eat."
that he could overcome his inclination,
from the Tree of Knowledge of Good and Evil
and he did not want to deceive
and this is why he said "and I will eat."
He blessed it with the light of the face;
as will become clear in the future.
And as said our holy Rebbe
of Izbitza, may the memory of the tzaddik be a blessing,
the phrasing of the pasuk will be read (Bereishis 2:16–17):
"Of every tree of the garden you may freely eat,
and of the Tree of Knowledge — good,"
and only "and evil" you shall not eat;
that he ate only of the good.
And so now the Children of Yisrael
and the thorn and thistle sprout
And this is what is written in the Midrash
כָּךְ הוּא כֹּחָהּ שֶׁל תְּשׁוּבָה וְכוּלֵּי
"Such is the power of teshuvah," etc.;
'A psalm, a song for the Shabbos day,'" etc.;
from the six days of Creation,
and from everything there will be "very good";
(וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב זֹהַר חֵלֶק ב קפד, א)
אֶלָּא הַהוּא דְּנָפִיק מִגּוֹ חֲשׁוֹכָא וְכוּלֵּי
but that which comes out of the darkness," etc.,
but that which comes out of evil."
And this is what is said:
וַיַּרְא אֱלֹהִים אֶת כָּל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה
"And God saw all that He had made,
and behold, it was very good";
and as is written in Bereishis Rabbah (9:4):
if only you would find favor before Me
just as you found favor before Me
And this is the meaning of "and be gracious to you,"
and this is "He blessed it with the light of the face."
